verdict.rationale: Greptile explicitly reviews every PR automatically and now detects when a PR was authored by a coding agent, routing it to a different model reviewer (Claude reviews GPT-authored code and vice versa), directly matching the 'verifying agent-authored code' story. It layers in a dedicated AI security agent, sandboxed runtime testing (TREX), custom rule enforcement, and scales via Docker/Kubernetes deployment options to review at volumes beyond manual review, with real-world corroboration of catching genuine issues before human review. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data comparing agent-generated vs human-generated PR review accuracy, and quantified throughput/volume claims beyond deployment tier descriptions.
